content: Dependency parsing involves tagging a word based on different features to indicate if it is dependent on another word. The Freeling library also has dependency parsing models for Portuguese. Since we wanted to build a SRL (Semantic Role Labeling) module on top of the dependency parser and the current released version of Freeling does not have an SRL module for Portuguese, we trained a different Portuguese dependency parsing model that was compatible (in terms of used tags) with the available annotated.
